geometryOrigin: Original parametric standalone shirt geometry authored from the ATEL-47 brief; no source outfit mesh imported, isolated, or modified.

screenedReference.usage: Inspected only as a visual candidate; attached skirt and uniform panels were excluded. No source geometry or UVs reused.

displayEnvelopeMeters.source: Measured from the current standalone gray GLB; display envelope only, not garment manufacturing size.

uv.frontBackPanels: U left-to-right across each independent panel; V=0 at shoulder and V=1 at hem, so vertical stripe artwork stays upright.
uv.sleeves: U wraps around each sleeve; V=0 at shoulder and V=1 at cuff.
uv.details: Collar stand/leaves, cuffs, placket, buttons, and shoulder caps are distinct named meshes and material groups.

status: Shape candidate for independent QA; not shape-approved, surface-ready, or published.
